title: PGuard: A Native, Streaming, and Plug-in Guardrail for Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: As streaming generation becomes the dominant serving paradigm for both text-only and multimodal large language models, ensuring safety throughout the generation process has become a critical challenge. We introduce PGuard, a native, streaming, and plug-in guardrail that transforms safety monitoring
